title: REQ · GameLayout renders the 80/20 desktop split with Tailwind and no page scroll
summary: Tailwind grid 4fr/1fr, full viewport, overflow hidden, independent story scroll
description: Context: the desktop split is defined in legacy CSS (grid-template-columns 4fr 1fr, min-height 100vh). Desired behavior: GameLayout expresses it with Tailwind utilities, uses h-screen and overflow-hidden, and gives the story aside its own overflow-y-auto. Expected result: no page scroll or horizontal overflow on desktop. Why: the layout keeps the game dominant.
acceptance_criteria: Given GameLayout rendered, when its root element is inspected, then its classes include grid, h-screen, w-full, overflow-hidden and md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr].
Given GameLayout rendered, when the aside is inspected, then its classes include overflow-y-auto and md:h-screen, and the scene main includes min-w-0.
Given the stylesheet, when html, body and #root are read, then they have height 100% and overflow hidden.

in_scope: GameLayout root, main and aside classes
